desc:
Beat dummies, open chests, collect trolls and build the strongest team in Trollge Rebirth.

HOW TO PLAY
- Hit dummies to drop chests full of items, then use them to get trolls
- Evolve your trolls with chest items and complete quests for special ones
- Roll mutations and forge traits to power up your favorites
- Mine ores in The Deep and craft gear at the Blacksmith
- Open skin cases from the shop for exclusive skins

PLAY TOGETHER
- Trade with anyone using ;trade
- Open your own stall at the Market and sell trolls, items and skins
- Create or join a Guild and challenge other guilds to fights
- Take on bosses and climb the Battle Pass for limited rewards

COMMANDS
;trade (user) - send a trade request
;check (user) - view a player's trolls
;filter - choose which items get auto-deleted
;oldfilter - auto-delete Oil and Blood cups
;clearinv - clear your inventory
;openbags - open every TrollCoin bag
;low - drop to 1 HP (to check phases)

Codes are in the Menu.
